detailed_rack: Bring jumars for the fixed lines.
QDs and a small assortment of Camelots. Bring mountaineering gear if conditions call for it.
Carry glacier equipment. If icy or late in the season, additional screws to protect running belays, or a second axe, may be wanted, depending on ability.
A 30 m rope suffices for belayed or simul-climbed sections. Bring a set of nuts plus 4-5 cams to hand size; no fixed protection was found. Add snow and ice equipment if the route holds either.
A single fixed piton protects the 5.3 step. Bring standard mountaineering gear.
A crevasse kit is prudent, especially for the lower-glacier approach. Ice screws and pickets could add security if required.
Gear on the lower part is reportedly clean. To know what the 5.12 summit roof needs, rappel in and jumar to look. Rusty buttonheads remain just under the rim, so use care.
